label: Pío Baroja
description: Spanish novelist born in San Sebastián, member of the Generation of '98, author of Zalacaín el aventurero.

label: Miguel de Unamuno
description: Spanish writer and philosopher born in Bilbao, rector of the University of Salamanca, author of Niebla.

label: Francisco Goya
description: Spanish romantic painter and printmaker, court painter, author of The Disasters of War.

label: Joseba Sarrionandia
description: Basque writer and poet, member of the Pott group.

label: Fernando Aramburu
description: Spanish writer from San Sebastián, author of the novel Patria about the Basque conflict.

label: Frank Gehry
description: Canadian-American architect who designed the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao.

label: Santiago Calatrava
description: Spanish architect and engineer who designed the Zubizuri footbridge in Bilbao.

label: Richard Serra
description: American sculptor whose installation The Matter of Time is at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao.

label: Jeff Koons
description: American artist whose flower sculpture Puppy stands outside the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao.

label: Louise Bourgeois
description: French-American artist whose spider sculpture Maman stands in Bilbao.

label: Pablo Picasso
description: Spanish painter, author of Guernica about the bombing of the Basque town in 1937.

label: Joan Miró
description: Catalan painter and sculptor of surrealist works.

label: Maurice Ravel
description: French composer born in Ciboure in the French Basque Country, author of Boléro.

label: Pablo Sarasate
description: Spanish violinist and composer from Pamplona.

label: Juan Gris
description: Spanish cubist painter who worked in Paris.

label: Eduardo Chillida
description: Basque sculptor known for monumental abstract works such as the Comb of the Wind in San Sebastián.

label: Jorge Oteiza
description: Basque sculptor, painter and writer, author of Quosque Tandem.

label: Bernardo Atxaga
description: Basque writer, author of the novel Obabakoak.

label: Aurelio Arteta
description: Basque painter from Bilbao, known for murals of workers and fishermen.

label: Rafael Ruiz Balerdi
description: Basque abstract painter from San Sebastián, member of the Gaur group.
